3177.title: Mobile attachment preview disappears after file selection
3177.rootCauseOneLine: The mobile follow-up composer collapses on file-picker focus loss, attachment state does not restore expanded layout, and compact layout does not mount the attachment preview.
3177.proposedFix: Keep mobile follow-up composers expanded whenever attachment count is nonzero, preserving explicit wide-layout collapse and resuming normal compact behavior after the last attachment is removed.
3177.caveats: The direct run used real Chrome file selection with a mobile touch viewport rather than a physical Android device; the same compact-state failure was repeated in a second clean checkout.
